solution.title: Exchange Edge Transport Server Deployment & Hardening (Hybrid)

products.name: Exchange Edge Transport Server Deployment & Hardening (Hybrid) — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy and harden the Exchange Edge Transport role — EdgeSync subscription, connectors + accepted domains, anti-spam/connection filtering, OS/TLS hardening, and secure mail-flow validation — so perimeter transport is correct and secure. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Deploy and harden the Exchange Edge Transport role the right way

The Exchange Edge Transport server sits in the perimeter to handle inbound/outbound SMTP and a first layer of hygiene — and misconfigured, it becomes an open relay or a mail-flow bottleneck. This solution deploys and hardens Edge: subscribe it to the Exchange organization (EdgeSync), configure send/receive connectors and accepted domains, apply anti-spam/agent and connection-filter settings, harden the OS/TLS posture, and validate secure mail flow — so the perimeter transport is correct, secure, and monitored.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Edge Transport role in a hybrid perimeter: EdgeSync, connectors, transport agents/anti-spam, TLS, and how it complements cloud hygiene.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (on-prem Exchange org + Edge host, network/firewall/DNS, certificates, admin access).
  • Implementation Guide — install the Edge role, create + import the Edge Subscription (EdgeSync), configure send/receive connectors + accepted domains, apply anti-spam/connection filtering, harden OS/TLS, and validate secure inbound/outbound flow — pilot-first, each object named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (EdgeSync healthy, no open relay, TLS enforced, mail flows) plus Best Practices for a secure, maintainable Edge tier.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A perimeter Edge Transport tier that's correct and secure — EdgeSync healthy, no open relay, TLS enforced, mail flowing — the hardened front door to your messaging estate.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-AntiSpamReport.ps1 — Read-only anti-spam / connection-filter posture report for the Edge Transport server
    • Get-EdgeReadiness.ps1 — Read-only readiness/discovery for an Edge Transport deployment (host, AD LDS, ports, DNS, EdgeSync)
    • Get-EdgeScopeHealth.ps1 — Scope/health helper — consolidated read-only Edge health: EdgeSync, connectors, queues, cert expiry
    • Set-EdgeConfig.ps1 — EdgeSync / connector setup helper — reports current state and stages changes with -WhatIf (safe by default)
    • Test-OpenRelay.ps1 — Read-only open-relay + TLS posture validator for the Edge SMTP listener (Gate C)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
